decisions.reason: Launched only a year ago with unresolved prospects and low carrying cost on its own web page, the injection unit remains a valuable option in the construction repair market.
A second resin injection unit overlaps somewhat with A, but its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little, so the option is retained for now.
Automatic airless guns fit the firm's core spray business and cost little to keep while market uptake is still resolving.
A manual airless gun is a core accessory that sells alongside the pumps, so carrying it costs little and it complements the established business.
The air-assisted airless line with several models is still young and uncertain, its carrying costs are moderate, and it extends the core offering, so the option is kept.
The data logger is a more novel digital option whose value is highly uncertain but cheap to maintain, which favors keeping it until demand becomes clearer.
